commit.message:
Recognize moon.mod and moon.pkg as MoonBit Config (#8196)

* Recognize moon.mod and moon.pkg as MoonBit Config

Add a separate data language for MoonBit module and package manifests,
reusing source.moonbit for syntax highlighting. Cover filename detection,
the highlighting scope, and exclusion from default language statistics.

Both samples are copied unchanged from moonbitlang/async and individually
licensed under Apache-2.0:
- moon.mod: https://github.com/moonbitlang/async/blob/a37e4658068eee4f684a770025e0dc4b9f1df69f/moon.mod
- moon.pkg: https://github.com/moonbitlang/async/blob/a37e4658068eee4f684a770025e0dc4b9f1df69f/src/moon.pkg
- License: https://github.com/moonbitlang/async/blob/a37e4658068eee4f684a770025e0dc4b9f1df69f/LICENSE

Usage searches (exact filenames, excluding forks):
- https://github.com/search?type=code&q=NOT+is%3Afork+path%3A%2F%28%5E%7C%5C%2F%29moon%5C.mod%24%2F
- https://github.com/search?type=code&q=NOT+is%3Afork+path%3A%2F%28%5E%7C%5C%2F%29moon%5C.pkg%24%2F

* Recognize MoonBit manifests using the existing language entry

Add moon.mod and moon.pkg as MoonBit filenames and move the unchanged samples into its filenames directory. Remove the separate data language, its generated grammar listing, and the redundant test; existing sample-based detection tests cover both filenames.

Validation: 2043 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 1 skip. Classifier cross-validation passes with 14 errors at the allowed threshold.

---------

Co-authored-by: Bao Zhiyuan <baozhiyuan@idea.edu.cn>
